dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Functional neurological symptom disorder (functional gait disorder/astasia–abasia) causing incongruent, distractible knee-buckling falls, without evidence of structural neurological or epileptic disease

ALTERNATIVE 1: Intentional symptom production, such as malingering or factitious disorder

ALTERNATIVE 2: Cardiovascular syncope or drop attacks, not fully excluded because orthostatic measurements and ECG were not performed

ALTERNATIVE 3: Cataplexy, although the absence of emotion-triggered episodes and preserved postural control makes it unlikely
